item.title: Busbar Systems Standards and Compliance: A Complete Engineering Guide
item.description: Electrical standards exist for a single practical reason: to ensure that equipment performs safely and reliably in service, across all the edge cases and worst-case conditions that no individual manufacturer, engineer, or user can anticipate alone. For busbar systems, this means defining how much current a busbar can carry without overheating, how much fault current it can withstand without mechanical failure, how it should be tested before installation, and what markings and documentation prove it meets those requirements.
